title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Thompson (hamstring) will not be activated this week
items.desc: The Cowboys did not activate S Jalen Thompson for this week.
items.impact: Thompson will remain on injured reserve for Dallas.

items.title: Ihmir Smith-Marsette released by Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Treylon Burks (foot) off injury report Monday
items.desc: Treylon Burks is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Burks returned to practice on Saturday after he was absent on Friday. He'll be a borderline WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rachaad White (heel) listed questionable Monday
items.desc: Rachaad White is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Bengals.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) listed questionable Monday
items.desc: Jacory Croskey-Merritt is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Croskey-Merritt was a full participant in practice all week. He is trending in the right direction to be activated from IR.
